mathematical_or_algorithmic_definition: Provisional harmonic families having a base retained peak and at least one HARMONIC member.
notes: Families without harmonic members are not ranked.
Encoded as negative value in ascending selection tuple.

mathematical_or_algorithmic_definition: Number of accepted harmonic relationships with the family base.
notes: Count may include competing targets at the same order before canonical member-per-order resolution.
Structural score, not a physical probability.

mathematical_or_algorithmic_definition: Median of |observed-predicted|/delta_f_R over family harmonic relationships.
Maximum of |observed-predicted|/delta_f_R over family harmonic relationships.
Sum of stored alias-advisory flags in the provisional family record.
notes: Advisory burden is a ranking key, not an automatic veto.

mathematical_or_algorithmic_definition: Power of the family base retained peak.
Frequency of the family base retained peak.
One-based retained rank of the base peak.
notes: Rank derives from dominant-first NMS traversal.

mathematical_or_algorithmic_definition: Select the retained base peak of the rank-1 family.
If no eligible family exists and the frozen dominant peak exists, select the dominant peak.
If neither an eligible family nor dominant peak exists, minimize (frequency, retained_rank).
Within selected family/order minimize (normalized residual, absolute residual, -power, -relative power, frequency, retained rank, retained_peak_id).
notes: Competing same-order members are preserved with duplicate_harmonic_order_member reason.
